name: catholic-solutions-saas-platform

scripts.build:production: npm run build:platform && npm run build:cfr && npm run build:admin && npm run build:legacy-switcher-bridge
scripts.build:staging: npm run build:staging --workspace @catholic-solutions/cfr && npm run build:staging --workspace @catholic-solutions/platform-admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @catholic-solutions/app-switcher && npm run typecheck --workspace @catholic-solutions/cfr && npm run typecheck --workspace @catholic-solutions/platform-admin

description: Catholic Solutions SaaS control plane with CFR end-user portal, Super Admin console, centralized app registry, and universal App Switcher
